meta.promptText: India mein men ke liye konse brand ki formal shirts kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Haan — India mein **men’s formal shirts** ke liye main in brands ko prefer karunga:

1. **Louis Philippe** — ⭐ **Best overall / premium**
   - Elegant, sophisticated look
   - Office + important meetings ke liye excellent
   - Roughly ₹1,500–₹3,500 mein achhe options mil jaate hain. [indianretailer.com](https://indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/compare/marks-spencer-vs-van-heusen-vs-arrow-formal?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paisawapas.com](https://www.paisawapas.com/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. **Van Heusen** — ⭐ **Best for daily office wear**
   - Comfortable aur easy-care options kaafi achhe
   - Regular, slim aur other fits available
   - Sales mein ₹800–₹1,500 ke aas-paas bhi good shirts mil sakti hain. [indianretailer.com](https://indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/compare/marks-spencer-vs-van-heusen-vs-arrow-formal?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paisawapas.com](https://www.paisawapas.com/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Louis Philippe Men Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,524*

### [Van Heusen Men Solid Formal]()
*₹840*

### [Raymond Men Cotton Fawn Solid Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,127*

### [Arrow Men Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,143*

### [Park Avenue Men Cotton Blue Textured Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,301*

3. **Arrow** — ⭐ **Classic & premium formal**
   - Conservative corporate dressing ke liye bahut suitable
   - Tailored/non-iron options ke liye bhi jaana jaata hai. [indianretailer.com](https://indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **Raymond** — ⭐ **Classic quality**
   - Traditional, polished formal look
   - Senior/professional appearance ke liye achha choice. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

5. **Park Avenue** — ⭐ **Best value**
   - Modern-looking formal shirts
   - Sales mein ₹900–₹1,500 range mein kaafi good options mil rahe hain.

6. **Peter England** — 💰 **Budget-friendly**
   - Agar ₹1,000–₹2,000 ke andar multiple shirts leni hain, good value option. [indianretailer.com](https://indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/compare/marks-spencer-vs-van-heusen-vs-arrow-formal?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paisawapas.com](https://www.paisawapas.com/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Meri personal ranking
**Louis Philippe > Arrow ≈ Van Heusen > Raymond > Park Avenue > Peter England**

Agar aap **office ke liye 4–5 shirts** lena chahte ho, main suggest karunga:
- 2 × **White**
- 1 × **Light blue**
- 1 × **Light pink/lavender**
- 1 × **subtle blue/grey stripe**

Aur **plain full-sleeve + spread/regular collar + well-fitted (not skin-tight)** lo — brand se bhi zyada important fit hai.

Agar aap apna **budget (₹1,000 / ₹1,500 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000 per shirt)** bata do, main us budget mein **best 5 shirts** choose karke de sakta hoon.
